verdict.line: You lose if you let him land Cryptic Gaze and trade in melee before level 6; you win by poking from 680 range the entire lane, which is why Teemo sits at 53.7% over 162 games here.

brief.thesis: Sion has no ranged tool — Cryptic Gaze (Q) only reaches 550 and Death's Caress (W) only 100 — while Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot both reach 680. As long as you never stand inside his Q range unprompted, he physically cannot punish your poke, and the matchup becomes a pure attrition war you win on numbers alone.

theirWindow.what: At ranks 1-5 it's up every 12-8s with a 550 range stun; if he's walking up with it available, stay at 680 range or hug a wall so the stun can't set up a W shield + auto trade.

yourWindow.when: His Q (Cryptic Gaze) just missed or is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Step up and unload autos for Toxic Shot stacks plus a Blinding Dart; the blind removes his only answer (autoattacking back) for its full duration.

powerCurve.note: Sion's stun all-in trades roughly even
Toxic Shot ranked up, outpoking his melee engage
Level 6 Cannibalism heal sustains his all-ins
Mushroom zoning offsets his ult sustain

start.why: Hits 56.5% over 46 games and gives the attack speed to stack Toxic Shot faster, which matters more here than Doran's Ring's mana since E costs nothing to use.

boots.why: 53.5% over 71 games; the magic penetration scales your poison DoT and Blinding Dart damage through Sion's growing health pool from Enrage kills.

core.why: On-hit proc and movement speed let you kite autos into Toxic Shot stacks without ever entering his 100-range W or 550-range Q.
Burn stacks off your poison DoT punish a melee bruiser who has to stand in range to do anything back.
Cooldown reduction gets Blinding Dart back online faster to blind every single one of his engage attempts, 60% win rate over 55 games on this exact path.

situational.when: you are already ahead and want the burst to punish him onto half-cast W shields
the enemy team starts stacking magic resist against your poke

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards three consecutive ranged autos for Toxic Shot stacking — it punishes Sion for walking up into Blinding Dart range to trade instead of rewarding a melee all-in.

summoners.why: 87.2% pick rate at 51.6% win rate; Ignite converts a successful Blinding Dart blind-and-poke sequence into a kill since Sion has no gap-close to escape it.

playing.title: Poke from 680, not 550
playing.detail: Stay at Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot's 680 range at all times — that's 130 units outside his Cryptic Gaze and worlds outside his Death's Caress.

playing.title: Blind before he swings
playing.detail: Save Q (Blinding Dart, 8s cooldown) for the moment he commits to Enrage and starts autoing; blinding him negates the AD-for-health trade entirely.

playing.title: Don't fight into his W shield
playing.detail: If he pops Death's Caress point-blank, back off instead of trading — the shield absorbs your poke and explodes on expiry or detonation, so walking away denies the trade for free.

playing.title: Camouflage between pokes
playing.detail: Stand still after landing a volley to go Invisible, then re-engage with the Element of Surprise attack speed bonus for a free extra round of Toxic Shot.

playing.title: Respect level 6 onward
playing.detail: Once he hits R (Cannibalism, 90s cooldown), his lifesteal and attack speed let him win extended melee trades he'd lose to poison alone — disengage rather than slug it out.

playing.title: Zone with mushrooms, not melee
playing.detail: Place Noxious Trap (R) in brush and jungle entrances so the slow and damage deny his engage angles without you ever stepping into his Q range.

playing.title: Push waves, skip his all-in window
playing.detail: Enrage burns his own health for AD, so let him dump it into the wave and tower instead of your face — a shoved lane removes his free all-in chance.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from real games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning for why those numbers hold — range differentials, cooldown windows, skill-order timing — is this brief's own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being Sion’s fully charged Decimating Smash (Q)!
